figures.caption: Figure 1: Agentic framework overview. Policy documents are segmented by chunking agent, structured into KG by extraction agent, then traversed by a retrieval agent to synthesize policy-grounded answers.
Table 1: Scores by model, condition, and task type (mean over 5 runs). H = heuristic (0–1), J = LLM-asjudge (1–5). Overall shows mean ± std. Each model uses its own KGs. Best H per model-task bolded.
